name: Engineering Problem Solving Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating large language models on engineering problem solving, paired with hierarchical-reasoning prompting methods.
reputation: Recent preprint proposing an engineering-focused problem-solving benchmark with hierarchical prompting; limited adoption so far.
notes: Requires precise numerical/engineering verification and often programmatic checking; potential evaluation ambiguity; possible training-data contamination; not yet widely benchmarked across many models.
